title: Life Insurance Policy
description: An issued life insurance policy contract, as an underwriter, a lender taking a collateral assignment, or a policy-review service reads it: who is insured and who owns it, what coverage it provides and on what terms, what it costs over time, and the contract provisions that govern lapse, conversion and claims.

insurer.description: The insurance company issuing the policy.

name.description: The insurer's legal name, as printed on the cover page.

address.description: The insurer's address as printed on the cover page, joined into one line.

policy_number.description: The policy number, exactly as printed on the cover page.

policy_form_number.description: The policy form code printed in the page footers or headers, e.g. 'P08TRM'.

product_type.description: The kind of insurance as titled on the cover page, e.g. 'Term Life Insurance'.

policy_date.description: The Policy Date, from which policy years and anniversaries are measured, in ISO format YYYY-MM-DD.

insured.description: The person whose life is insured, as shown in the policy data.

sex.description: The Insured's sex as printed, e.g. 'MALE'.

issue_age.description: The Insured's age at issue, printed beside the sex.

risk_class.description: The underwriting risk class, e.g. 'STANDARD NONSMOKER'.

owner_name.description: The policy Owner's name as printed on the cover page.

face_amount.description: The Face Amount of basic coverage in dollars, as a number without currency symbols or commas.

initial_modal_premium.description: The initial premium at the requested payment interval, as printed on the cover page and policy specifications.

amount.description: The initial premium amount in dollars, as a number.

payment_interval.description: The requested premium payment interval, e.g. 'MONTHLY', 'ANNUAL'.

coverage_to_age.description: The attained age at which coverage ends, e.g. 95 for 'Coverage to Age 95'.

expiration_date.description: The policy Expiration Date from the policy specifications, in ISO format YYYY-MM-DD.

conversion_period_end_date.description: The last date on which the policy can be converted to permanent insurance, in ISO format YYYY-MM-DD; null if the policy is not convertible.

is_convertible.description: True if the cover page or provisions say the policy is convertible.

is_participating.description: True if the policy shares in the insurer's surplus (participating); false if it is described as non-participating.

free_look_days.description: The number of days the Owner has to return the policy for a full refund under the Free Look Right.

riders.description: Each rider or additional coverage listed in the summary of coverages, besides the basic coverage.

coverage_cease_date.description: The date the rider's coverage ceases, in ISO format YYYY-MM-DD.

modal_premium_factors.description: The factors applied to the annual premium to calculate premiums for other payment modes, from the policy specifications.

semi_annual.description: The factor for semi-annual premiums, e.g. 0.510.

monthly.description: The factor for monthly (pre-authorized check) premiums.

annual_policy_fee.description: The annual policy fee in dollars that the premium tables state is included in the premiums shown.

basic_coverage_premium_schedule.description: The table of guaranteed annual premiums for basic coverage, one entry per policy year, across every continuation page of the table.

annual_premium.description: The annual premium for that year in dollars, as a number.

premium_waiver_premium_schedule.description: The table of annual premiums for the premium waiver rider, one entry per policy year.

annual_premium.description: The rider's annual premium for that year in dollars, as a number.

provisions.description: Key terms from the contract provisions.

grace_period_days.description: The length of the premium Grace Period in days.

reinstatement_period_years.description: The number of years after the end of the Grace Period within which a lapsed policy may be reinstated.

reinstatement_interest_rate_percent.description: The annual interest rate in percent charged on past-due premiums at reinstatement.

incontestability_period_years.description: The number of years in force after which the policy cannot be contested.

suicide_exclusion_period_years.description: The number of years from the Policy Date within which death by suicide limits the proceeds to premiums paid.

claim_payment_period.description: How soon the insurer will pay death benefit proceeds after receiving the required proof, as stated, e.g. 'within two months'.

late_claim_interest_rate_percent.description: The additional annual interest rate in percent paid when payment of proceeds is delayed beyond the stated number of days.

minimum_income_benefit_interest_rate_per.description: The guaranteed minimum annual interest rate in percent on the Fixed Income benefit plan.
